item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Brændende kærlighed, Danish 'burning love', buttery mashed potatoes topped with crispy bacon and parsley. Served with pickled red onions and pickled beetroot on the side. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Spanish paella with rice, chicken, sausage, fish and blue mussels, topped with parsley and peas. Served with roasted padrón peppers, ensalada mixta and lemon on the side. (3+5+14+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: alubia paella with rice, lima beans and vegetables, topped with parsley and peas. item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Confit duck leg with pumpkin, mushrooms, wheat kernels and herbs, served with a light jus. (1+10+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Spiced bean patty with pumpkin, mushrooms and wheat kernels with herbs. Served with a fresh herb sauce, served tempered. (1+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Jerk chicken with beans and dirty rice, served with crisp coleslaw. Jamaican vibes. (13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Jerk aubergine with beans and dirty rice, served with crisp coleslaw. Jamaican vibes. (13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Lechon Asado, Cuban roast pork, with roasted sweet potatoes and onion mojo, a Cuban sauce with citrus and garlic, topped with parsley. Served with crispy banana chips, chilli sauce and ensalada cubana with avocado dressing on the side. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Grilled Cuban-spiced king oyster mushrooms with roasted sweet potatoes and onion mojo, a Cuban sauce with citrus and garlic, topped with parsley. Served with crispy banana chips, chilli sauce and ensalada cubana with avocado dressing on the side. (6+15)
